indications: Aripiprazole tablets are an atypical antipsychotic. Aripiprazole tablets are indicated for: • Schizophrenia ( 14.1 ) • Acute Treatment of Manic and Mixed Episodes associated with Bipolar I Disorder ( 14.2 ) • Adjunctive Treatment of Major Depressive Disorder ( 14.3 ) • Irritability Associated with Autistic Disorder ( 14.4 ) • Treatment of Tourette's Disorder ( 14.5 )
